plain_summary: This page serves as the title page for the Transnet National Ports Authority Port Tariffs book. It specifies that it is the Twenty Third Edition, effective from 1 April 2024. It lists the issuer's name and address, the ISBN, and the website where the tariff book is available. The page also includes a disclaimer stating that Transnet National Ports Authority cannot assure the book is error-free and will not be liable for losses arising from such errors.
